mapper.select: select distinct a.*,b.THIRD_ID as dingUserId from SYS_USER a join AUTH_THIRD_USER b on a.ID = b.USER_ID where a.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and b.CATEGORY='DingDing'

select distinct a.*, b.THIRD_ID as dingUserId, c.ID as personnelId, c.ID_NUMBER idCardNumber, d.NAME orgName from SYS_USER a join AUTH_THIRD_USER b on a.ID = b.USER_ID left join PERSONNEL c on a.ID = c.USER_ID left join SYS_ORG d on a.ORG_ID = d.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and a.USER_STATUS ='ENABLE' and b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and b.CATEGORY='DingDing' and c.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and d.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE'
